prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one understated 32dp Android settings icon. Primary request: redesign as a quiet refined flat duotone UI pictogram for a pale blue and white mobile app. Style: FLAT 2D matte icon, consistent medium-fine rounded strokes, restrained muted cornflower blue (#5D87C5) with very pale blue (#E8F0FA) small fills. Clear simple silhouette readable at 32px. Exactly one isolated centered icon occupying 70% of a square canvas, balanced whitespace. Genuinely transparent alpha background. No 3D, no bevel, no highlights, no shine, no shadows, no large colored backing tile, no gradients, no surrounding decoration, no badge, no watermark or caption. Aim for calm everyday utility, never a glossy toy or app-store promotional icon. Subject: a simple circular globe outline, one vertical oval meridian and one horizontal equator. Use only a few precise rounded blue strokes and optional very faint blue interior tint. No continents, stand, or letters.
